name: Kinetic Cosmos
promise: The portfolio as an orrery: four rings of real links around one luminous core, and every chapter opening on its own orbit.
description: A controlled expressive composition. One inset stage opens the page: the thesis as the headline, and the system of four rings, Work, Writing, Record, and Personal, drawn as an orrery whose plates are real links wired to their bodies by leaders, turning slowly while in view, with a visible pause. Each ring follows as a chapter that opens on its own orbit line carrying its section links; each section opens on an orbit rule; a closing stage mirrors the opening with the ways out; a dock says which ring you are in; and an index lists every section on its ring. The motion, on the kit runtime, only adds to a still composition that is complete without it.

sources.note: The orbital opening and the forking timeline, rebuilt as the redesign's orrery: the system of rings as the navigator, its plates real links, on the v3 records.
